title: archive.ingest output
description: status=pending means the demand stands; status=in_progress means the exact approval was consumed but the command is not yet settled (a crashed run — `odind archive ingest` resumes and settles it); status=ingested means the deterministic exact-scope R3 demand was minted (or already stands) and authorizes nothing until the operator decides; the material carries the approval id, its exact revision, both binding digests, and the exact approve command. status=ingested means the approval was consumed at-most-once and the bounded ingest report is durable; status=replayed means this exact command was already executed and the stored outcome is returned unchanged.
